Introduction

This review integrates molecular mechanisms, biomarkers, and therapeutic strategies in Alzheimer disease.

Amyloid

Amyloid biology is evaluated using genetic, biochemical, imaging, and neuropathological evidence.

APOE

APOE-associated mechanisms are separated from downstream biomarker and treatment implications.

Immune system

The immune section distinguishes microglial states, inflammatory signaling, and disease-stage effects.

Biomarkers

Biomarkers are organized by biological target, specimen type, analytical method, and intended use.

Amyloid plaque biomarkers

Amyloid plaque biomarkers include imaging and fluid-based measures with different clinical roles.

NFT biomarkers

Neurofibrillary tangle biomarkers are assessed for staging, prognosis, and treatment monitoring.

Neuroinflammation biomarkers

Neuroinflammation biomarkers include PET targets and fluid markers of astrocyte and microglial activity.

Therapeutics

Therapeutic approaches are grouped by disease target, evidence stage, and expected clinical effect.

Disease-modifying treatments

Disease-modifying treatments are compared using mechanistic rationale and trial-level evidence.

Conclusions

The conclusion summarizes established findings while preserving uncertainty and remaining limitations.
